title: Mining the Data for Cobalt

reader_summary.headline: While many of us increasingly live in digital worlds, and even as software eats the world.
reader_summary.overview: While many of us increasingly live in digital worlds, and even as software eats the world. One of the most important resources on the planet is cobalt, which is used in batteries, among other things. Hi and welcome to the A16Z podcast.

key_points.text: While many of us increasingly live in digital worlds, and even as software eats the world.
key_points.evidence_quote: While many of us increasingly live in digital worlds, and even as software eats the world, we still rely on a myriad of devices that depend on resources from the physical world.

key_points.text: I'm Hannah, and this episode is all about the exploration for and mining of minerals, specifically cobalt.
key_points.evidence_quote: I'm Hannah, and this episode is all about the exploration for and mining of minerals, specifically cobalt.

key_points.text: In this conversation, I'm joined by Kurt House, CEO and co-founder of cobalt metals, Professor John Thompson of Earth and Geosciences at Cornell.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this conversation, I'm joined by Kurt House, CEO and co-founder of cobalt metals, Professor John Thompson of Earth and Geosciences at Cornell, and A16Z general partner on the consumer team, Connie Chan.

key_points.text: We explain why it is that cobalt is suddenly one of the most important and in-demand metals on the planet.
key_points.evidence_quote: We explain why it is that cobalt is suddenly one of the most important and in-demand metals on the planet, and how technology is transforming how we find it and the mining industry as a whole.

thesis: The episode explains that cobalt is critical for batteries because it forms a stable layered crystal structure that enables high energy density, fast charging, and long cycle life. It argues that as the world transitions to electric vehicles and rebuilds its energy infrastructure, the demand for cobalt will increase significantly, necessitating the discovery of new sources using advanced data and technology.
